title: II-Bench: An Image Implication Understanding Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces II-Bench to evaluate the higher-order perceptual and reasoning abilities of MLLMs through image implication understanding (e.g., metaphors and symbolism). While the benchmark includes domains such as society and psychology, it does not contain a specific evaluation or benchmark for religion, faith, or formal systems of ethics and morals. The 'Ethics Statement' and 'Limitations' sections are standard academic disclosures and do not constitute a benchmark of these topics.
